blockers.description: Could not open a detached agent window from the manual desktop surface in this environment.

blockers.description: Required additional desktop environments for VAL-FLOAT-004 were unavailable.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Verified active environment and proceeded with macOS-only evidence capture; no way to provision Windows/Linux surfaces within mission constraints.

summary: Tested 17 assertions: 0 passed, 0 failed, 17 blocked. Primary blocker was inability to open a detached window from this automation-accessible manual surface; VAL-FLOAT-004 was additionally blocked by missing Windows/Linux environments.
